描述_EN: different scores were awarded to the player depending on whether the arrows landed in the wider mouth opening or in the lugs on the side. however no pitch pots from such early periods have survived, so we do not know whether their shape has changed over time. it was used in a game which started in china in the 6th century bc and involved throwing arrows into a pot. we know from literary sources that this game was played in the 6th century bc. this vase with two lugs on both sides of the mouth is called a 'tou hu' ( 'pitch pot'). this vase with two lugs on both sides of the mouth is called a 'tou hu' ('pitch pot').
描述_ZN: 根据箭是落在较宽的口中还是落在侧面的耳孔中，玩家会得到不同的分数。 然而，没有如此早期的投掷壶被保存下来，所以我们不知道它们的形状是否随着时间而改变。 它被用于公元前6世纪在中国开始的一种游戏，涉及到把箭扔进一个罐子。 我们从文学资料中得知，这种游戏在公元前6世纪就已经开始了。 这种口部两侧有两个耳坠的花瓶被称为 "tou hu"（"沥青罐"）。 这种口两边有两个耳的花瓶被称为 "投壶"。
